finalText:
**Bigger than a rename, and four places must not change.**

`account_id` shows up in 94 files, 1082 times.

| Where | Why not |
|---|---|
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/*` | generated, vendored, marked "do not edit" |
| `lib/serialize.js` `WIRE` map | public API field, frozen by `docs/openapi.yaml` contract |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | public API schema, external clients read this name |
| `migrations/*.sql` | already applied in prod, editing breaks history |

Everywhere else (JS params, SQL inside repo files, `lib/audit.js`) is safe to rename.

Next: a DB column rename needs its own migration, separate from this code change.
